composite_rule.weak: mean of available provider low target prices
composite_rule.normal: mean of available provider mean target prices
composite_rule.strong: mean of available provider high target prices
composite_rule.quick_missing_policy: continue with Yahoo+IFIS when both are valid

notes: IFIS/QUICK are licensed sources; missing credentials or coverage remain missing.
QUICK target range is aggregated from current broker target-price rows, not invented from earnings consensus.
Analyst target prices are not 5-10 business-day profit targets.
Missing values are never replaced by zero or neutral.
